messages.content: A boy has 5 cards and each card has three anime characters on it. His brother has 3 fewer cards than he has. How many cards do they have together?

content.text:
The boy has 5 cards.

His brother has 3 fewer cards: 5 − 3 = 2 cards.

Together: 5 + 2 = **7 cards**.
